source_brief.scene: A spectacular finite dry-stage ocean made of low cyan wave LED contours, with original humpback whale replacement outline sculptures in four separate supported bays. Hero one bright giant silver-blue breaching whale at the apex; the other three outlines are dark ghost frames. Four bottom storyboard cells show emerging whale, rising whale, curved airborne apex, flukes returning toward waves. Black negative space, no real water effects or actual moving whale.
